selected_sources.subject: Combinatorics
contribution_roles: Lean and Mathlib: upstream APIs and named source credits
explicit_premises: Action is standard Sum(actual keyed rooted occurrence batch)Unit; ValidRootedState only adds actual structural WellFormed proof to existing RootedState fiber. No replacement State/path or desired decoding equation is introduced.

Noncomputable applyAction invokes actual PrefixTableBatch.step or PrefixTableCheckpoint.compactAt with their proved invariant. executeAt is the actual chronological List.foldl; execute exposes the existing State. execute_root and execute_wellFormed derive actual retained root and invariant, and execute_nil is exact identity.

projectBatches actually erases compact actions with List.filterMap, keeping batch order and empty batches. decode_executeAt derives actual Option decoded full rows = original decoded rows ++ chronological flatMap traceRows of projected batches. decode_execute identifies actual checked histories with existing Batch.run(projectedBatches); execute_histories exposes that exact old-plus-new law.

The actual producers and proofs require initial WellFormed and DecidableEq of full typed tags; no independent Key/vertex equality, finite vertex assumption or generic cache authority. Root is retained separately even with no actual rows.

selected_sources.subject: NumberTheory
contribution_roles: Lean and Mathlib: upstream APIs and named source credits
OpenAI: exact omega/lambda/primitive-root reduction slice in FiniteFourier; Xavier Roblot and named imported Mathlib authors retain individual credit
explicit_premises: Use exact admitted K=CyclotomicField3ℚ and O=NumberField.RingOfIntegers K. Actual omega=(IsCyclotomicExtension.zeta_spec3ℚK).toInteger and lambda=omega-1; actual omega is primitive order3 and lambda is nonzero.

Exact good reduction: for every actual ideal P of O with P.IsMaximal and lambda∉P, Ideal.Quotient.mk P omega is primitive order3. Actual local quotient field, cube equation and nonidentity are proved; no desired quotient primitive-root supplier is assumed.

Actual ramifiedIdeal=Ideal.span{lambda}. The actual lambda element is prime; the actual ideal is prime, nonzero, maximal, proper and has actual Ideal.absNorm3, by pinned Mathlib cyclotomic norm/prime suppliers and actual number-ring instances.
lambda belongs to this ideal,3 belongs and2 does not. The actual quotient image of omega is1; it is not primitive3. Thus actual maximality alone cannot replace the good-prime exclusion.

Actual good maximal nonvacuity: ideal(2) is proper because its admitted norm is4. Choose an actual maximal P containing it. If lambda∈P, actual3∈span{lambda}⊆P and actual2∈P imply1∈P, contradicting properness. Therefore an actual maximal P above(2) with lambda∉P is produced.

Actual primary-normalization obstruction: no p:O satisfies ramifiedIdeal=span{p} AND lambda² divides p-1. The proof is local to this actual ideal: p and p-1 would both belong to it, forcing1 in a proper ideal. No general lemma is misplaced under this cyclotomic subject.
